_: mika#1950 — aggregate reading of measurement-2026-09-20.jsonl. Produced by scripts/measure-pilot-cycle-emptiness; every figure here is re-derivable from the .jsonl with the jq shown in README.md §4. This file is the LECTURE, the .jsonl is the DONNÉE.

corpus.note: The corpus is live. A re-run on a later day reads more sessions; this artifact is the 2026-09-20 snapshot.

the_symptom_itself._: mika#1910's symptom is the guardrail EVENT, not the config constant. Anchor: `[guardrail] empty_response:` after stripping ANSI and the cpp#168 line stamp.
the_symptom_itself.reading: The symptom the ticket asks for a verdict on does not occur anywhere in this corpus. Zero, not few.

models._: AC3 — established from the data (the `model` field of each line), never assumed. `unknown` is a literal the producer writes (`log_init(session_id or "", model or "unknown", task_id)`, agent.py:591) when the SDK reports no model; it is an absence of data, not a hidden model.

empty_breakdown._: AC4 — and it is reported WITH its negative control, because the control is what decides whether the figure means anything.
empty_breakdown.reading: policy:deny sits at 50.6% of empty sessions and 50.0% of productive ones. It does NOT discriminate: half of every session is refused a tool and gets on with the work. error_during_execution discriminates weakly (50.6% vs 35.7%). Neither explains emptiness.

guardrail_aborts._: Types are captured, never presumed. `error_max_turns` is absent from guardrails.py::_abort's Literal[...] — it reaches log_guardrail from agent.py:842 as an SDK termination subtype.

calendar_split_at_the_glm_swap._: F2 — this axis is CALENDAR, not regime. The population runs under Claude on both sides of 2026-08-26, so the GLM swap changed the model of none of these sessions. The split is reported because the ticket's framing invites it, and because its result is the cleanest negative control available.
calendar_split_at_the_glm_swap.reading: No discontinuity at the swap date. 51.3% before, 47.3% after. The real inflections are elsewhere: July→August (up) and late August→September (down).

within_september_model_contrast._: The only window where two models coexist, hence the only place model and calendar partially separate. Both are Claude; neither is GLM.
within_september_model_contrast.reading: Within one month opus-4-8 is ~3.5x emptier than opus-5 — but opus-4-8 itself fell from 79% in August to 19.5% in September, so calendar moves too. Neither axis is isolable on this population, and the plan's R4 reserve (three substrate changes) applies in full.

founding_measurement_cross_check._: Verification Contract §4. The 120 most recent sessions as of 2026-08-29 — the population the 2026-08-30 doctrine cites as '102 of 120 sessions silent'.
founding_measurement_cross_check.reading: 118/120 reproduces 102/120 in order of magnitude, so the script is not refuted by the known measurement. And 120 of 120 ran under claude-opus-4-8 — zero under any GLM. This is the criterion that triggers U4.

verdict.returned: SANS OBJET — the premise is refuted, which is an answer
verdict.why: A FIXED/IGNORED/AGGRAVER verdict compares a symptom across two models. On this population the symptom (empty_response) occurs 0 times in 2353 sessions, and no session runs under either candidate model. There is nothing to compare, and fabricating a verdict to fill the box would be the defect this work exists to avoid.
verdict.attribution_reserve: mika#1665 (empty reclassified as ReasoningBudgetExhausted), mika#1996 (the detector itself), mika#2296 (llm_max_tokens raised) all moved between the founding measurement and now. Even had the population discriminated, a difference could not be attributed to a model.
